finding2_ternary_parity_vocab.claim: binary {eq,neq,lt,le} vocab cannot express a XOR/parity constraint, so GF2RowSpace (affine wall) was unreachable. Added arity-3 parity head {none,even,odd}.
finding2_ternary_parity_vocab.verdict: WIN. binary α CANNOT express parity (F1 0, 0% routed; its 0.218 GF2-solve is from pins alone). +ternary: 100% of instances now carry α-emitted parity constraints, parity-F1 0.567, and routing α's compiled (A,b) through the certified GF2RowSpace faculty solves 0.575 of determined queries (2.6x). Solve ceiling is bounded by parity-read F1 (0.57); backbone is neutral for parity (as expected — vocabulary, not consistency). Deferred: arity>3 parity, directed modular sum (a+b=c mod d>2).

ablation: Finding1: base->mp isolates architecture (+), base->backbone isolates cell-attention (-), LINEAR isolates representation (floor). Finding2: 2x2 backbone x ternary shows ternary is NECESSARY (backbone alone emits 0 parity) and sufficient; backbone neutral.
